steps.title: Filter raw Hi-C sequences
steps.instruction: Filter raw Hi-C sequencing data in Fastq format and reference genome (the result of SOAPdenovo2) using HiC-Pro (v. 2.8.0).

substeps.instruction: Keep all other parameters as default

steps.title: Prepare data with Juicer
steps.instruction: Run Juicer (v. 1.5) to prepare data for 3D de novo (v.170123) assembly using valid pairs reads.

steps.instruction: Run 3D de novo (v.170123) assembly to assemble into chromosomes.
